target_customer: Mid-sized and large businesses with procurement, supply chain, finance and operations workflows
problem: Critical operations run on brittle or off-the-shelf software; Khotan lets forward-deployed engineers rebuild them as maintained custom applications on the company's own data.
business_model: B2B software platform with forward-deployed engineering (pricing not public)
product_category: Forward-deployed engineering platform, custom procurement software

founders.name: Adeep Mitra
prior_employers: Transfoorm (founding engineer, about 5 months, BHP internal tooling, per one profile)
previous_startups: Marketing and events agency, Access Brisbane
founders.background_notes: YC profile says he scaled an agency to five figures at 17.

founders.name: Corey Berther
education: Rocket science degree (left, per YC profile)
previous_startups: Electronics business by 16 and a tech house by 18 (YC profile)

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs data ingestion across structured and unstructured sources and generated applications with approval rules, achievable by a two person team using current AI tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Customer-specific rebuilt systems could create lock-in, but the platform layer is easy to imitate and the team is two people.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know; coverage dated 2025 to 2026 shows AI labs and many startups adopting the forward-deployed model.

market_need_then: Forward-deployed engineer job postings grew sharply in 2025 per a research teardown, and AI makes bespoke software cheaper to build; evidence of Khotan-specific demand is not public.

branding.domain_note: Operates on khotan.com; acquisition details unknown.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, practical, direct; short declarative lines such as 'Agents can't fix data they can't trust'

rebrands.why: Not stated in any source found; the product also moved from hospitality and supply chain toward a forward-deployed engineering platform

brand_strength.rationale: Brand is months old; no press about the brand itself and the name meaning is unexplained.

pivots.from: Hospitality technology (UQ Ventures Food Innovation Challenge origin)
pivots.to: Supply chain platform (as described at YC admission)
Khotan, forward-deployed engineering platform for procurement and operations

outcome_analysis: Khotan is a two person Brisbane founded company that joined YC in Winter 2026 after two earlier rejections and renamed itself from Pollinate. It is too early for an outcome. The only reported capital is the roughly $500K initial funding at YC admission. The main risk is a crowded forward-deployed engineering field where Palantir and AI labs already operate.
notes: Funding conflicts: Business News Australia and VCBacked say $500K, Dealroom shows $125K; the $500K figure fits the amount reported at YC admission but the split is not sourced. Neuronfeed and VCBacked disagree on stage (seed vs pre-seed), so stage is recorded as other. Palantir entry rests on an undated article, so source_date is null. Transfoorm detail comes from a single profile. Rebrand date is not sourced. Competitor evidence from 2026 is the batch era; confidence is low because competition and funding are thin. Palantir and its forward-deployed engineer model were the obvious incumbent but only undated sources were found, so the competitor list is empty and Palantir appears in takeover_risk_then only.
